localizedDescriptions.en: Search public web pages and collect structured content with Firecrawl.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 使用 Firecrawl 搜索公开网页并提取结构化内容。

en: Find the latest public release notes for the named project and summarize their breaking changes with links.
zh-CN: 查找指定项目最新的公开发布说明，总结其中的破坏性改动并附链接。

instructions.en: Create an API key in your Firecrawl team dashboard and enter it in plugin settings. The available tools and limits depend on the team.
instructions.zh-CN: 在 Firecrawl 团队控制台创建 API 密钥，再填入插件设置。可用工具和额度依团队而定。
